hero.title: Special Intensive Revision
hero.subtitle: Verify your voter details quickly and easily.
hero.description: The Election Commission of India is conducting a special drive to ensure every eligible citizen is correctly registered as a voter. Complete your verification today.

whatIsSir.title: What is SIR?
whatIsSir.subtitle: Understanding the Special Intensive Revision of Electoral Rolls
whatIsSir.description: SIR (Special Intensive Revision) is a flagship programme of the Election Commission of India to verify, update, and clean electoral rolls across the country — ensuring every eligible citizen's vote counts.

features.title: Door-to-Door Verification
features.desc: Booth Level Officers (BLOs) visit every household to verify voter details in person.

features.title: Remove Duplicates
features.desc: Duplicate and bogus entries are identified and removed from the voter list.

features.title: Add New Voters
features.desc: Eligible citizens who are not yet registered get added to the electoral roll.

features.title: Update Records
features.desc: Changed addresses, names, and other details are corrected in the voter database.

whatIsSir.keyFact: More than 49 Crore electors received SIR Enumeration Forms in Phase II across 12 States/UTs.

whyImportant.title: Why Is It Important?
whyImportant.subtitle: Your verified vote is the foundation of democracy

cards.title: Prevent Duplicate Entries
cards.desc: Ensure your vote is unique and cannot be duplicated by anyone else.

cards.title: Keep Details Updated
cards.desc: Accurate name, address, and photo on the voter roll ensures smooth voting.

cards.title: Stay Registered
cards.desc: Eligible citizens who miss verification may be removed from electoral rolls.

cards.title: Improve Election Accuracy
cards.desc: Clean voter lists lead to fair, transparent, and accurate elections.

cards.title: Exercise Your Rights
cards.desc: Voting is a fundamental right. Verification protects your right to vote.

cards.title: Strengthen Democracy
cards.desc: Every verified voter strengthens India's democratic process.
